chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad al-Jawharī, from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr, from Sulaymān ibn Hilāl, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, concerning:

Regarding a man who does that with a man, he said: He said, “If it is short of penetration, then the hadd punishment applies; but if he has penetrated, he is to be made to stand, then struck with the sword, and the sword takes from him whatever it takes.” I said to him: Is that killing? He said: “That is so.”
ai.seo_question: What punishment does this hadith assign for liwat with and without penetration?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liwat, distinguishing between an act falling short of penetration and one involving penetration. It specifies that the hadd punishment applies in the former case, while in the latter case the punishment is execution.
